newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan police kill 10 in week of tackling crime.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan police kill 10 in week of tackling crime.

text.p: Kenyan police shot dead four alleged criminals in a campaign to counter violent crime in Nairobi, raising the weekly toll to 10.
Police officials said a plain-clothes officer, travelling in an unmarked car, was hijacked by three armed men in a Nairobi suburb on Saturday.
When the car later stopped in a deserted area the policeman, who had not been searched, shot one of his abductors. The other two escaped .
In another incident on Saturday police shot dead three men who had been arrested on suspicion of involvement in a series of robberies.

Officials said the men had agreed to show police where guns were hidden in a sisal plantation outside Nairobi, but one of them seized an AK-47 assault rifle and fired at the police. The police returned fire, killing all three.
Police Commissioner Shadrack Kiruki recently announced "total war" on criminals after growing public concern at a rising volume of crime in the Nairobi area.
Gun-toting criminals have carried out daring raids on banks in the city centre and suburbs, and scores of cars have been hijacked at gunpoint in recent weeks.
